The place for every hour

An all-day bar in Drosia

Con Voi opens at seven in the morning and stays with you until late at night. Coffee and brunch before work, a burger or a bowl at lunch, a glass of wine with friends, cocktails and music on Friday night.

Velvet sofas, green marble tables, brass details and plants everywhere. Sit inside, upstairs or outside under the trees of Drosias–Stamatas Avenue — the kitchen is open all day.

A lively, special place — with honest flavours.

Good to know

Frequently asked questions

Anything else? Call us on 210 813 6771.

What are your opening hours?

Every day from 07:00 in the morning. Sunday to Thursday we close at 01:00, Friday and Saturday at 02:00. On public holidays it is best to call us first on +30 210 813 6771.

How do I book a table?

By phone on +30 210 813 6771, or with the «Reserve a table» button on our Google Maps profile. For our themed DJ nights you can also book on +30 694 960 3525.

What can I have in the morning?

From early in the morning we serve coffee, fresh juices and brunch: eggs benedict, scrambled eggs with a bagel, omelettes, croque madame, savoury or praline pancakes, tsoureki French toast, avocado toast and a chia bowl.

Do you have meat-free options?

Yes — for example avocado toast, oyster mushrooms with avocado tzatziki, the green bowl with grilled halloumi, the quinoa bowl, pinsa, porcini risotto and tagliatelle tartufata. If you have an allergy, please tell us before you order.

Can I order food to take away?

Yes, you can pick up your order from the restaurant. Call +30 210 813 6771 and we will tell you when it will be ready.

Do you have outdoor seating?

Yes. There are tables outside under the trees of Drosias–Stamatas Avenue, an indoor room with velvet banquettes, and more seating upstairs.

Do you host music nights?

Yes. From time to time we host themed nights with a DJ — Greek nights, disco, carnival parties. We announce them on our Instagram, @convoi__.

Come and see us

Hours & how to find us

Drosias–Stamatas Ave 2, Drosia 145 72 210 813 6771

We are at number 2 on Drosias–Stamatas Avenue, in Drosia (Dionysos municipality) — an easy drive from Ekali, Stamata, Rodopoli and Agios Stefanos. Look for the lit CON VOI sign and the tables under the trees.
